name: CG · 04 Error Handler
description: Shared error workflow: logs any failed production execution of the content workflows to the content_errors Data Table.

parameters.content:
## CG · 04 Error Handler
Set as the **error workflow** of the intake, pipeline and gateway workflows. n8n runs it whenever one of their production executions fails unexpectedly (model failures are handled inside the pipeline and do not land here).

Each failure becomes a row in **content_errors** with a link to the failed execution. Add a Slack or email node after **Format Error** to get alerts.
